legal_entity: Page footer names CoinJar Australia Pty Ltd (ACN 648 570 807, ABN 75 648 570 807, AUSTRAC-registered VASP); the page does not say which CoinJar entity contracts with affiliates.
application_conditions: Online form on the affiliates page ('a member of our Affiliate Team will be in touch'); aimed at website and email-newsletter partners, content creators and influencers on Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok who have 'built an audience'. No named affiliate platform.
paid_action: Trading fees generated by a referred new customer (tracked through a unique referral link).

commission.model_note: '50% of a customer's trading fees for the first two years' (24 months from the referred customer's sign-up). Nothing specific to the CoinJar Card: card spend is not stated as a paid action.

payout.method: Deposited into the affiliate's CoinJar wallet
payout.frequency: Monthly ('Each month we'll deposit your earnings in your CoinJar wallet')
payout.holdbacks_note: Not stated; no affiliate-specific terms linked (footer links general Terms of Service). A UK 'affiliate marketing guidelines' page exists (coinjar.com/uk/affiliate-marketing-guidelines), not read in this run.

rules_note: Programme countries listed on the page: Australia, the US, the UK, Ireland and Germany. The CoinJar Card itself is only available in Australia, so only Australian referrals could involve the card. Nobody contacted, no application made.
allowed_countries_note: Australia, United States, United Kingdom, Ireland, Germany (as listed on the affiliates page).

evidence.title: CoinJar Affiliates (coinjar.com/au/affiliates)
evidence.excerpt: '50% of a customer's trading fees for the first two years'; unique referral link; 'Each month we'll deposit your earnings in your CoinJar wallet'; partners: websites, email newsletters, creators on Twitter/LinkedIn/Facebook/YouTube/Instagram/TikTok; countries Australia, US, UK, Ireland, Germany; apply via online form; no cookie window, threshold or affiliate terms stated.

notes: Official publisher programme exists (revenue share on trading fees, not on card usage). Separate customer referral programme (support article 212209223 'CoinJar Referrals') not read in this run. Commissions never influence ranking.
